regime_context: Hong Kong's narrative rotation shows a narrow, non-directional leadership structure: only 4 of 17 themes are trend-gate eligible (Banks, Energy, High-Dividend, Conglomerates), with Banks the leader and Energy the challenger. The detector's validated edge is drawdown/shake-out control (gate_helps=true), not return forecasting; momentum ranks are display-only. Nearly all themes (13 of 17) are ineligible, so this is a defensive, income-led tape with no broad momentum. The one scorable theme (China Tech & Internet) is ineligible and ranked 13/17, so no high-conviction scorable call exists.
emerging_watch: Watching China Platform Megacaps (rank 14, score -1.115, eligible=false): if it climbs above rank 10 AND becomes eligible=true (absolute-trend gate) on rising breadth, that would retire the watch and signal a confirmed tech handoff — currently no evidence of that.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks lead the rotation (rank 1, score 1.498) and pass the absolute-trend gate (eligible=true, durability_bar 0.69, breadth 0.692), which is the detector's one validated risk-control leg. It is not crowded (crowding_z 0.94 but crowded=false) and not a one-narrative tape, so leadership is broad enough to hold. The lean is a trend-following stance consistent with the validated gate, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Banks in HK are rate-sensitive and policy-exposed; a sudden China property-credit event or rate surprise reversals could snap the trend, and the detector's own track record says its momentum edge is rank-IC ~0 — leadership can persist or stall without warning.
